        {"type": "material_conflict", "expression": "x1 * x4 == 0", "description": "Titanium Alloy Conflict"},
    ]
    num_variables = len(resources)

    program = QuadraticProgram(
        variables=[str(i) for i in range(num_variables)],
        quadratic_objective=[

        ],
        linear_constraints=[],
        quadratic_constraints=[

            ]

            program.quadratic_constraints.append([

            ])

    embedding = QuadraticEmbedding(num_variables, num_variables)
    program.embedding = embedding

    # Translate to Dsl
    dsl_translator = DslTranslator()
    dsl_program = dsl_translator.translate(program)

    # Solve the problem using COBYLA
    optimizer = COBYLA(maxiter=100)

    # Extract the results

    selected_orders = [
